answer: Give every identity a fable to tell and a bond that unlocks only as that story proves real and distinct. Score accounts on independent signals — answer coherence, peer links, timing variance — then fingerprint behavior: a farm's clones share one plume of identical traces, so a single signature marks the whole swarm. When a group trips the similarity threshold, each member forfeits its unvested bond at dawn of detection. Cheap per clone, but exposure is cluster-wide, so sybil cost scales with swarm size.
